newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: National up 1.8 percent on loan news.
newsitem.headline: National up 1.8 percent on loan news.

text.p: Shares of National Development Bank Ltd rose 1.8 percent or five rupees to 285 on Tuesday on news that the bank had raised a foreign loan, brokers said.
"The news that the bank has raised $50 million to lend to the small and medium sector and boost its loan portfolio has pushed up the share price," said a local broker.
NDB said on Tuesday it had raised $50 million in a 10-year syndicated loan guaranteed by the Sri Lanka government and the Asian Development Bank.
National Development Bank is one of two blue chip development finance institutions listed in Colombo.
